summary: Plant Care keeps a household's house plants on the device. The user adds a plant with a name, a room, and a watering interval in days, records a watering with Watered today, sees which plants are due for watering today, and deletes a plant after confirming. Plants persist across restarts.
targetUsers: People who keep house plants at home and want to remember when each one needs water
goals: Keep a list of house plants with name, room, and watering interval
Record that a plant was watered today
Show which plants are due for watering today
Remove a plant after the user confirms
Keep plants on the device and restore them after restart
nonGoals: Plant identification, diagnosis, or care advice
Sharing plants with other people or syncing across devices

features.name: Plant list with due status
features.userOutcome: The user sees every house plant with its name, room, and watering interval, and can tell which plants are due for watering today.
features.trigger: The user opens the app or returns to the main screen.
features.behavior: Shows all stored plants, newest created first, each row showing the plant name, room, and watering interval in days. A plant is due for watering today when it has never been watered or when the calendar day of its last watering is at least its watering interval in days before today; due plants are marked as due in the list. When no plants are stored, the list shows the text 'No plants yet. Add a plant to start tracking watering.'
features.failureOutcome: Stored plants cannot be read, so the list shows no rows and the app continues running.
acceptanceSignals: With no stored plants, the list shows the text 'No plants yet. Add a plant to start tracking watering.'
A plant with a watering interval of 3 days whose last watering was 3 calendar days before today is marked as due.
A plant with a watering interval of 3 days whose last watering was today is not marked as due.
A plant that has never been watered is marked as due.
After a restart, the plants stored before the restart appear in the list with the same names, rooms, and watering intervals.

features.name: Add plant
features.userOutcome: The user adds a house plant with a name, a room, and a watering interval in days.
features.trigger: The user chooses Add in the window's header bar.
features.behavior: Opens a dialog with a name field, a room field, and a watering interval in days field. The name and room are required and the watering interval must be a whole number of at least 1 day. The Add button is disabled while the name or room is empty or the watering interval is missing or less than 1. Saving creates a plant with the entered values and no last-watered day, so the new plant is due for watering today.
features.failureOutcome: The entered values are rejected, so the dialog stays open and the Add button stays disabled.
acceptanceSignals: With an empty name, the Add button is disabled.
With a watering interval of 0, the Add button is disabled.
With a name, a room, and a watering interval of 7, choosing Add creates a plant that appears in the list with that name, room, and interval.
A newly added plant is marked as due for watering today.

features.name: Watered today
features.userOutcome: The user records that a plant was watered today.
features.trigger: The user presses Watered today on a plant in the list.
features.behavior: Sets the plant's last-watered day to today's calendar day and updates the list so the plant is no longer marked as due until its watering interval in days has passed.
features.failureOutcome: The watering cannot be recorded, so the plant keeps its previous last-watered day and stays in the list.
acceptanceSignals: After pressing Watered today on a due plant with a watering interval of 5 days, the plant is not marked as due.
After pressing Watered today, the plant's last-watered day equals today's calendar day.
After a restart, a plant watered before the restart is still not marked as due when its interval has not passed.

features.name: Delete plant
features.userOutcome: The user removes a plant from the list after confirming.
features.trigger: The user chooses Delete on a plant in the list.
features.behavior: Asks for confirmation in a dialog before removing the plant. Confirming removes the plant from the stored plants and from the list; cancelling leaves the plant unchanged.
features.failureOutcome: The plant cannot be removed, so the plant stays in the list and the confirmation dialog stays open.
acceptanceSignals: Choosing Delete on a plant shows a confirmation dialog.
Cancelling the confirmation dialog leaves the plant in the list.
Confirming the dialog removes the plant from the list.
After a restart, a plant deleted before the restart does not appear in the list.

dataObjects.name: Plants
dataObjects.purpose: The house plants the user keeps, with their room, watering interval, and last-watered day.
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Kept on the device until the user deletes the plant.

qualityRequirements: The due-for-watering check compares calendar days only, ignoring the time of day.
Plants are written atomically so a failed save leaves the previous stored plants unchanged.
productConstraints: The app works entirely on the device with no account or network connection.
A watering interval is a whole number of days and is at least 1.
